claim_boundary.qualified: The corrected five proposed nominal foam translations preserve at least 82.430 mm of the retained robot-to-90mm-model distance before common residual deductions and at least 2.0 mm of nominal physical boundary margin on the nearest side.

derivation.distance_rule: For a rigid translation t of one collision object, distance(A,B+t) is at least distance(A,B)-norm(t).
derivation.self_collision_effect: None. R placement changes the foam world pose only and does not change any robot self pair.

pair_scope_candidate.freeze_boundary: Exact pair-table and current URDF/SRDF/world hashes remain required before C-01.
pair_scope_candidate.robot_foam: all 23 robot collision bodies against r1_base_seated_foam_90x90x50mm at every R phase
pair_scope_candidate.robot_self: all 225 exact non-SRDF-allowed unordered robot self pairs at every R phase
pair_scope_candidate.support_contact: Only foam-to-support contact while BASE_SEATED is an intended world contact; it does not exclude any robot-to-foam pair.

physical_containment.correction: The earlier +/-5-mm draft would place a 75-mm foam edge exactly on an 85-mm boundary and therefore had zero, not 2.5-mm, nearest-side margin. Before any scored motion the draft is corrected to +/-3 mm.
physical_containment.decision: Add and use an 85 x 85-mm inner polygon centred inside the existing approximately 89 x 89-mm box. The inner polygon, not the outer box, is the scored placement boundary.
physical_containment.open_bound: Physical ruler/marking and centre-registration uncertainty must be strictly below the 2.0-mm nearest-side containment before final freeze.
